purpose: Machine-checkable evidence, dependency and temporal-history contract for the frozen NRVCA-005 stress fixture. Nothing here calibrates local water or energy outcomes.

probability_policy.rule: Scenario counts are not probabilities. Probability weights require a separately preregistered model and independent justification.

unknown.permitted_claim: The quantity is unknown; do not interpret missing as zero or available capacity.

synthetic_assumption.permitted_claim: Only tests deterministic logic, scenario handling, or policy sensitivity under declared illustrative assumptions.

expert_judgment.permitted_claim: A documented elicitation, not an observation or calibrated model.

official_observation.permitted_claim: An observation in the stated source, unit, coverage and reference period; not automatically a causal explanation or a future projection.

operator_measurement.permitted_claim: A recorded operational measurement within documented sensor, service, time and coverage limits.

published_estimate.permitted_claim: The source's estimate under its stated method and scope; not automatically a direct observation.

model_output.permitted_claim: A model output only at the declared version, configuration, input set and validation state.

methodological_sources.title: Decision-Making Under Deep Uncertainty
methodological_sources.claim_ceiling: Supports a description of the DMDU workflow; does not empirically support any stressor magnitude or local service result.

methodological_sources.title: A Beginner's Guide to Decision Making Under Deep Uncertainty for Water Utilities
methodological_sources.claim_ceiling: Supports water-utility planning method and practice context; does not calibrate the synthetic fixture.

methodological_sources.title: Investment Decision Making Under Deep Uncertainty
methodological_sources.claim_ceiling: Supports selection and combination of DMDU approaches; not a local measurement source.

stressor_definitions.meaning: Low source or inflow availability relative to an unspecified baseline.
stressor_definitions.limitations: No numeric inflow, hydrology series, catchment, date, baseline, or model is supplied.

stressor_definitions.meaning: Elevated demand under a heat-related stress condition.
stressor_definitions.limitations: No temperature series, demand response function, metered demand, or calibrated magnitude is supplied.

stressor_definitions.meaning: A grid-disruption event that affects powered infrastructure in this fixture.
stressor_definitions.limitations: No outage duration, grid telemetry, local feeder, backup topology, or failure-rate model is supplied.

stressor_definitions.meaning: Powered pressure-management equipment is unavailable in the fixture's grid-disruption model.
stressor_definitions.limitations: The grid dependency is a scoped fixture assumption, not a universal causal law for pressure-system outages.

stressor_definitions.meaning: Repair crews arrive later than the unstated baseline.
stressor_definitions.limitations: No roster, travel-time distribution, parts availability, dispatch log, or repair-time model is supplied.

stressor_definitions.meaning: Previously available reserve capacity has been used before another disruption occurs.
stressor_definitions.limitations: The fixture has no explicit storage mass balance or reserve state trajectory; required history is declared separately.

dependency_rules.rationale: The current synthetic scenario defines this powered-system outage as a consequence of grid disruption. Real models must represent other possible causes explicitly.
The current repeated-disruption fixture combines depleted reserve with low source availability; this is a scenario design constraint, not a general physical law.
A reserve-depleted state must have a prior event and drawdown; a scenario label alone is not enough.

evidence_transition_policy.rule: Evidence tier changes only when required provenance and review gates are satisfied; changing labels, descriptions, or source metadata alone cannot promote a claim.
evidence_transition_policy.official_observation_gate: Exact source identity, access/retrieval record, valid time, unit, geography/coverage, licensing state and SHA-256 digest of acquired bytes where bytes are available.
evidence_transition_policy.model_output_gate: Model identity/version, configuration digest, input-manifest digest, outputs with valid time/unit/coverage, explicit validation status and retained failure cases.
evidence_transition_policy.empirical_claim_ceiling: A sourced observation or model output is not by itself evidence of causality, policy effectiveness, or a calibrated counterfactual.
